text:
marta: Quick thread  need a call on the "Microcommit Starter" SKU. Proposal on table: make it a soft-limited tier (10k tokens/day) + auto-topup credits instead of separate add-on. This changes launch criteria and contract language. Thoughts?

owen: I like simplifying SKUs but auto-topup means new billing flow (prepaid credit + topup rules). That touches checkout, billing pipeline, and CPA math. We should model revenue impact.

viv: Sales: customers like clear predictable caps. Some SMBs prefer a single monthly cap rather than weird per-token topups. Auto-topup could surprise them unless opt-in is explicit.

marta: Good catch. We can make auto-topup opt-in on signup and default to off. For opt-out customers we show a UI warning: "You may hit cap and be throttled."

raj: Eng: technical pieces: quota enforcement at the edge, per-customer token counters, and safe topup hooks. Quota is doable in 2 sprints if we avoid real-time topup flows for GA. I recommend: implement cap + manual topups for GA, defer auto-topup until M2.

grace: RevOps: manual topups map nicely to existing billing invoices (we can create an internal invoice line). Auto-topup requires wallet accounting in billing pipeline -> more QA. Manual is lower risk.

lina: Legal: contract language must be explicit about throttling behavior and refund policy for prepaid credits. Also need opt-in consent copy for auto-topup if we go that route. I can draft both short clauses.

yuki: Design: Landing page should make cap + topup behavior obvious. If we do manual topup for GA, UI is straightforward: "Buy more credits" CTA. Auto-topup requires additional affordances in account settings and notifications.

pm-bot: Release window: 2026-09-01. Current SKU PRs: 6 open. Blocking: 2 affecting billing.

marta: OK proposal adjusted: Ship Microcommit Starter as capped tier with manual topups only, auto-topup deferred to M2 behind an explicit opt-in. This reduces billing scope and UX complexity. Please confirm impact on launch criteria.

owen: Launch checklist impact (short): "cap enforcement in edge router; billing hook for manual topup; UI CTA + payment flow; clear refund & throttle language in TOS; validation tests for 99th percentile throttle path."

raj: Engineering acceptance: "per-tenant counters implemented; throttle enforced at gateway; manual topup API + billing webhook; smoke and chaos tests for cap behavior". Estimate: 2 dev sprints for the full set minus auto-topup.

grace: Ops acceptance: "manual topup invoice flow tested; reconciliation script for prepaid lines; alerting on rapid credit usage". I'll own runbook.

lina: Legal will post draft clauses: 1) prepaid credits + refund rules 2) throttling behavior + notice. Reviewing comms before send.

yuki: I'll deliver updated checkout mock and the billing page CTA (due Thu). Add a microcopy line: "Manual topup only for GA; auto-topup opt-in planned for M2."

viv: Sales asks: add a simple handoff playbook so AE can offer a temporary committed-bucket pilot (manual) to close deals. I'll coordinate with Grace.

marta: Decision recorded: Microcommit Starter -> capped GA with manual topups; auto-topup opt-in deferred to M2. Action items:
- raj: implement counters + throttle + manual topup API, link to billing webhook (due EOD + follow-up ticket)
- grace: ops runbook + reconciliation script + alerts (due Thu)
- yuki: checkout + billing UI updates + microcopy (due Thu)
- owen: financial model for prepaid bucket vs simple cap (due Thu)
- lina: draft legal clause and review customer-facing comms (due Thu)
- viv: sales playbook + pilot offer template (due Fri)
- marta: update roadmap and GA launch doc; add milestone "Microcommit auto-topup M2"

pm-bot: Ticket created: PROD-15022 (microcommit-starter-cap-ga).

marta: If any team hits a blocker that forces us to change course on caps, escalate here. Cheers :rocket:

raj: ack. Creating follow-up tickets for perf tests.

grace: ack. I'll sync with billing on invoice payload fields.

oven: ack. I'll include sensitivity in the revenue model.

yuki: ack. Starting mocks now.

viv: ack. Will prep AE playbook.
